svg.text: 2D axial RoPE on Q, K only (not V)
flow executes d4 → d3 → d2 → d1 (coarse → full-res); numbered by resolution, not order

g.text: • no e5 — dilated r=2,4 pair → e4

svg.text: conv stage (blue): encoder ×2, decoder ×1 per box's own label; e5 dashed = ×2 + dilated ×2 (r=2,4)
transformer block: pre-norm MHSA + MLP, 2D axial RoPE on q, k
attention gate: α = σ(ψᵀ ReLU(Wₓx + W_g g)), pass-through init α₀ ≈ 0.95
output heads (heatmap · class); σ = sigmoid, losses on logits
Refiner (Stage 2, separate 97k-param network) — sub-pixel corner offset from a 24×24 crop
The 64×64 map covers only the central ±4 px capture window at 8× sub-pixel resolution (1/8-px cells); the surrounding
16-px ring is context via receptive fields, not answer space. Decode: soft-argmax over a 5×5 window around the peak →
offset d ∈ [−3.94, +3.94] px; refined corner = crop centre + d. Trained separately on jittered crops (d ~ U over support).
